title: deguelia javanica
intro: Deguelia javanica, commonly known as the "Tongkat Ali of Borneo," is a plant species native to Borneo, belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is used for its health benefits, which include enhancing immune function, improving cognitive performance, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Deguelia javanica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses.
